reviews.text: Thorough And prompt.  Takes time to explain all process of illness and treatment.  Thank you!!!!

We live on the west side. It was about a 40 minute drive but it was well worth it. They found out what was wrong with his leg. Informed me what I could do very informative and also took care of getting me medicine for buddy.. Very pleasant all of the staff
Front office team always friendly and professional. Office is clean and spacious. Appointments are seen on time. Very happy with this vet service.

Had a sick FIV boy they helped for two years. When it came time, with his health declining, they handled everything like oatmeal was their own. Thank you for making such a bad moment a peaceful experience
Thank you for the 5 star rating!

Dr. A was great, as always.  Very caring and attentive, explaining things in great detail and offering treatment alternatives. Did not feel rushed. She followed up the next day with further details and options.

I have been going to All Creatures since 2010. I have been using Dr. Bob as my primary veterinarian he is great, genuine and cares for my cats. He is in the business for his love of animals not for money. I only trust Dr. Bob to care for my cats he is the best veterinarian I have ever seen.
Very caring and compassionate people. I highly recommend
I have been taking my fur babies to Dr Bob for years and I wouldn’t go anywhere else.  They are loving, caring and compassionate and provide excellent care.  Highly recommend!!!!
Excellent service for my pet! They attended to her very quickly and it was a pleasant experience! Hazel, that's my cat's name, was very calm with her vet. 👌 10 out of 10

You guys are great.  Terrific front office.  Kelsey has an amazing ability to work with Maggie.  Her professionalism and skill is just great.
Truly cannot say enough about Dr. Bob.  He absolutely has our total confidence.  His thoroughness and professionalism is beyond reproach.  He takes all the time necessary to give a complete assessment and answer all of our questions.
Absolutely BEST practice in the valley!!
Bob Gernon
I've been taking my box turtle here for years. Great service, friendly staff, and reasonably priced on services.

Our dog isn't socialized to people she doesn't know. The vet and assistant did great with her, no fear even though pit bulls have a reputation. They solved the problem of her being protective by just taking her to the treatment area, away from us. The front desk staff were welcoming and friendly. I love getting text reminders of appointments. Our other dog we had got treatment for lymphoma at All Creatures. They were great with him too.
Dr. Bob at All Creatures Animal Clinic in Phoenix is caring and professional!  We will be back.  Thank you!
Thanks for the 5 star rating, Robert!

We have been going to All Creatures for 6+ years. They see our dog and our rabbits.  Wonderful staff, very nice and knowledgeable. Quick with email or phone responses to speak to the vets directly.  Dr Bob and Dr Nguyen are awesome!

All Creatures Animal Clinic has consistently been outstanding!

Julie and the rest of the front-of-house crew are always welcoming, helpful, and great to work with. A big shout-out to Julie and a huge thank you to the entire team for always taking such great care of us!

Dr. Miyamoto has also been outstanding and is another huge reason we continue coming back. It’s clear that everyone here genuinely cares about both the animals they treat and the people who bring them in.

I cannot recommend this clinic enough. Great people, great care, and consistently great experiences. 10/10 job, you guys, keep up the awesome work!
Always outstanding!

Amazing service from this  all Creatures Animal Clinic on Greenway.   Dr. Hooper is a very detail oriented VET and has help with our doggie issues with compassion, kindness and care.  All staff there is super friendly and responsive.  The clinic has excellent communication using all ways, phone, email, text.  Very  responsive and caring as well.
They weren’t transparent about the pricing and we weren’t informed clearly how much everything would cost together
Thank you for the 5 stars!
Amazing clinic, Dr. Wynne is exceptional
Dr. Bob and his staff are always 100% professional, efficient and friendly, very easy to work with. Would highly recommend them for any animal.
LOVE our Vet, Dr. Miyamoto!!! She takes such good care of our fur babies.

By dog was severely injured and on the brink of paralysis. Not only was our vet, but the entire staff phenomenal. We had probably asked easily over 50 questions and they had taken not only the time to throughly answer, but check in for clarity. In such a stressful and worrisome time, every single member of staff from the vet, techs, and those helping to clean up our dog when she soiled herself was the nicest people I’ve ever come across.
We appreciate you taking the time to rate us 5 stars, Eloisa!
Thanks, Dan!
Friendly and provided good information.
Staff is always very friendly!  Dr A was so kind and caring and attended to my dog with gentleness. Great place for your pets when they are in need of attention.
Doctors and staff are amazing.  Exactly where you want your pet!
Very accommodating and fairly priced . I have wire haired fox terrier.

Dr. Miyamoto is incredible!  She is so caring and spends a lot of time with her patients.  She was so sweet to Polly and when asked, recommended a plan of treatment for her Kidney disease.  There were so many options to choose from, but she gave me her honest opinion.  She is wise beyond her years and is one of the most thorough and caring vets I have ever met!
Excellent service and care from the moment I contacted them. Professional, clean, efficient - I have found my new vet!
The best doctor. Doctor Bob treats your pets with kindness and love
Thank you, Taylor!
Best care for my cat! Friendly caring staff 😊
Awesome as always! Thank you Doc Butler for your wonderful care for Perry
I love taking my fur kids to this vet.  They are so friendly and informative.  No judgement, just love for our animals.

I took my Pom on an emergency visit and they took me right in. We saw Dr A and appreciate the exam and the knowledge she had. We come back in 2 weeks after taking antibiotics and inflammatory. I hope she feels better soon but know that this vet is here for us if she doesn’t feel well. Thank you from mine and Chanel’s heart for getting us in.
Thank you for the 5 star rating!
Dog seen almost immediately.  Treaded well.
Dr. Mielke is amazing.  She is very through and my furbaby Buddy is always cared for patiently and lovingly!
I have been bringing my Babies to All Creatures for over 20 years. This dedication says it all 💖

Very prompt service during our trying time of year. Concern for our dog.
Dr. Bob is always very attentive and gentle with my high anxiety dog. Very patient to let me settle the dog and he doesn't rush the exam so he doesn't alarm her.
The staff here has been nothing short of amazing! They are kind, patient, and thorough. Cannot recommend this clinic highly enough.
Very honest and understanding people

I called worried about a bump on my rat, Chicken, and they were able to see him the same day! The appointment was smooth and efficient, and the staff were very friendly. Chicken rates All Creatures Animal Clinic 5/5 stars!

I love the vet I had her name was Morgan I think she’s the best and so was the tech I had she was also amazing of course ghost (puppy) was nervous but they were super sweet and I love how they email you right after your appointment on how everything we had discussed also i just love how they told me i can send a picture of his tail within and they’ll respond <3 this my permanent vet place for my pup :)

Updated: 8/6/26
Im very upset how the first thing this girls mouth from front desk Olivia was very rude even though I seen the door was open multiple ppl going in with their doggies with the techs and also because J have received an email saying 6:30am for earlier appointments from 6/11/26,  I may not had an appointment but I was there to pick up my nexguard that I couldn’t have delivered to my place because IDKY it says vacant and I paid extra for shipping for it have to returned to sender. No hello/ goodmorning even though i said “hi i’m ghost mom” “we don’t open til 7”…”im just here to pick up the nexguard from julie” “don’t open til 7” Olivia was really rude with her Responses

Greatest Veterinarian care ever!!! Love the staff at All Creatures Animal Clinic. I have taken our pets here for 30+ years. From front staff to technician assistants to Dr. Bob, I can never thank all of them enough for their great care and knowledge.  You will not find a better place to take your fur babies. I highly recommend!!!
Thanks, Paris!

Dr. Miyamoto is the absolute best. Calm, thoughtful, attentive, and she takes her time to ensure she delivers the best care. I bring all three of my dogs to her and they adore her. I also appreciate the timeliness and professionalism of the vet techs and receptionist at the practice. This is a very well run clinic.
Always very professional with great care for my pet.
Great people and they care about your fur babies!
Thank you for the 5 star rating!

They took good care of my hamster. I didn't feel rushed. They really care a lot even if your pet is small. Price was fair for the appointment and medication. Thank you to the office staff, technician, and Dr. Butler.
Love this group always on time, friendly, informative and always follows up to see how our fur baby is doing.  Highly recommended!
All Creatures is a very nice place and my dog feels comfortable going there also love how quickly they get our dog in and also paying inside exam room is awesome---thanks to all and Dr Wayne

Could be better. Wish they didn't have to charge my 5 year old cat with a "senior" comprehensive blood panel that includes fecal test and urine test. I just paid for a fecal test in April but there was no getting around their "package deal".  And they still want another 11 dollars for sand for the urinalysis test. Vet also recommended some 20 dollar supplement for immune support, which I paid for. Why again does he need this if his blood checked out normally?

Got veterinary food prescribed, vet said I could get anywhere I wanted. So I picked Amazon. Upon submitting the Amazon order, it said "waiting for vets approval". So I took initiative to call 'All Creatures Animal Clinic' . Front desk said they don't work with Amazon at all. They only work with local pet shops. So that's another miscommunication.
